_comment: Audio sources for the HU emulator. 'select' is the 0x61D '20 20 <select>' payload; record templates go to 0x628. Edit labels/codes freely; confidence reflects capture evidence (2026-09 car captures). 'extra' is the 2A status-message record (e.g. 'not connected'); it is sent only when no metadata is given. Media 'elapsed' is shown by the meter as 'Track N' (bench 2026-10-12).

sources.label: FM radio
sources.evidence: bench 2026-10-12: shows Preset, frequency and station; radio text not shown on the Audio page. cap2/button captures: 61D 20 20 02 01 00 then 628 20 0D band 01, PS name + radio text

sources.label: AM radio
sources.evidence: bench 2026-10-12: label, frequency, preset and station shown. 61D 20 20 01 01 00 then 628 20 0D band 10, freq 530/570 kHz
